responseMessageContents.text:
This screenshot proves the AWS account has **two IAM users under your name** (`Ivan@1` and `Ivan2@`) and **no user named `Rork1` is currently listed**.

That is important evidence: there is no visible Rork-owned IAM user to delete from this AWS account. **Do not delete either Ivan user.**

To complete the AWS proof safely, open the user you use to sign in and show only:
- **Permissions** page — confirms it is AdministratorAccess or equivalent
- **Security credentials** — confirms MFA is enabled  
Hide access-key IDs, account numbers, and any secrets.

Then I can record AWS as owner-controlled. No code, app data, deployment, or GitHub history will be changed.
